subject: Energy
title: Private Fusion Startups
description: A quick, practical guide to Private Fusion Startups.

hook.text: Dozens of private companies are now racing toward fusion—backed by over $6 billion in venture capital funding.

buildup.text: Commonwealth Fusion Systems uses high-temperature superconducting magnets—promising a smaller, cheaper tokamak.

discovery.text: TAE Technologies pursues a different approach—colliding beams of plasma to achieve fusion temperatures.

twist.text: Some startups claim fusion electricity by the early 2030s—far sooner than ITER's timeline, but unproven.

climax.text: Private money is bringing speed and innovation—but physics doesn't bow to venture capital timelines.

punchline.text: Startups bet billions—can private money crack fusion faster?

quiz.question: How much has private investment in fusion exceeded?
